description: DREAL Occitanie: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Occitanie. Coverage: DREAL Occitanie. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: [RTE] Postes électriques de la région Occitanie; [DREAL OCCITANIE] Centrales hydroélectriques; [DREAL OCCITANIE] Postes de livraison éolien en Occitanie; [DREAL OCCITANIE] Mâts éoliens en Occitanie. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, ZIP, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
